title: Balance the motion across the deck
description:
## Objective
Three features animated independently. Make it read as one deck.

## Spec Reference
`.devmeta/projects/2026-08-13-layout-overflow/2026-08-13-layout-overflow-spec.md` — Section 2

## Scope
**Files:** any of `slides/pages/*.md`, `slides/slides.md`

## Implementation
1. Read all three motion context logs FIRST — they record deliberate non-decisions.
2. Check consistency: does one section step everything while another steps nothing?
3. Remove over-animation. A slide whose bullets are one thought reads worse stepped.
4. Verify at least 5 slides carry reveals.

## Tests
Run: `cd slides && npm run build && npm run slides && npm run diagrams && cd slides && npm run layout`
acceptance_criteria: motion consistent; 5+ slides with reveals; all four checks green
closed_reason: motion measured and reviewed across the deck; 13/19 animated; no changes needed, reasoning recorded
